## Summary

Describe the change and the player problem it addresses.

## Testing

- [ ] Blood tested
- [ ] Frost tested
- [ ] Unholy tested
- [ ] World or Delve tested
- [ ] Dungeon or Raid tested
- [ ] PvP tested when relevant
- [ ] Voice playback tested when relevant, including the client locale
- [ ] No extracted audio or other game assets added
- [ ] No Lua errors with other addons disabled
- [ ] Public text and comments are in English
- [ ] No third-party code, talent strings, or artwork were copied
